note: Re-read RFC 2661 Section 5.8 and the current producer chain after ExtractParameters gained independent PPP LCP parsing. This requirement owns the configurable reliable-delivery retransmission budget, not the separate 5.8-3 clearing obligation. ExtractParameters still parses max-retransmit into Parameters.MaxRetransmit, tunnelDefaults and reliableConfig still carry it to both tunnel constructors, and ReliableEngine.Tick still exhausts that budget. TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel sets two before creating the tunnel, disables HELLO dead-peer detection, asserts Established through each allowed retransmission, and Closed after the next deadline. A fixed five fails the positive assertion; premature clearing fails the distinct negative assertions. TestConfig_MaxRetransmit separately asserts default five and an explicit nine; TestReloadAppliesMaxRetransmit asserts an explicit eight reaches reactor and new-tunnel defaults. The new PPP LCP parse does not alter this reliable-delivery setting or the existing tagged assertions.
